meta: Penetration Testing and VAPT Services | Argix
Penetration testing and VAPT for web apps, APIs, mobile apps, networks and cloud, with an audit-ready report for PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA.
h1: Penetration testing (VAPT) with a report your auditor can use
lead: Hands-on vulnerability assessment and penetration testing for web apps, APIs, mobile apps, networks and cloud, ending with clear findings, fixes and a retest.

items.p: Testing against the OWASP Top 10 and ASVS: authentication, access control, injection and business logic flaws.
External and internal testing of servers, firewalls, VPNs and Active Directory.
Testing of iOS and Android apps together with the APIs behind them.
Configuration and exposure testing for AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.
Prompt injection, data leakage and agent permission testing for LLM-based systems.
Goal-based attack simulation that tests people, process and technology together.

blocks.text: A penetration test report is evidence for your auditor. It supports compliance work but does not by itself make a system compliant or certified. Testing is done by our security engineers, separate from the developers who wrote the code.

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: How long does a test take?
Most web application tests take one to three weeks, depending on size and complexity. We confirm a schedule when we agree scope.
Will testing disrupt our live systems?
We agree rules of engagement first, prefer test environments where possible and coordinate timing for anything sensitive.
Do you retest after we fix the issues?
Yes. A retest of the serious findings is part of the service, and the final report shows what was fixed.
